contexts.text: That this is the case I can for certain asseverate...
From the continuous experience of years I can asseverate that it is most true...
If anyone can number the dust of the earth, thy seed also shall be numbered = asseveration.
When I read  from beginning to end, they said that they were in the interior sense of the Word only, asseverating that there is not a point in which there is not a spiritual sense...
Preface [end]. This I can asseverate, that they who come into the other life from the Christian world, are the worst of all...
I can asseverate that the Spirits who are with man know and observe the smallest things of his memory and thoughts...
Internal men, who have conscience, have no need to confirm anything by an oath... they can indeed say, with some asseveration, that it is so...

This I can asseverate, that man is in the other life immediately after death, and that his life in the world is just continued there, being the same in character as it had been in the world; this I can asseverate, because I know it. AC 8939:3.
The Angels... want me to asseverate from their mouth, that in the universal Heaven there is not a single Angel who was created [such] from the beginning...
I asseverate in truth that (these Memorable Relations) have not been invented, but have been truly done and seen... CL 26.
